Read `AGENTS.md`, the approved Change Brief, Gate A system design, and current repository evidence.

Specify exact files/modules/symbols, APIs/schemas/state, dependencies, error/retry behavior, compatibility/migration, tests/oracles, telemetry, rollout/rollback, validation commands, and ordered implementation slices.

If an architectural decision is missing, reopen Gate A instead of inventing it here. Stop before coding and hand to a fresh Implementation Plan Critic.
